QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Starling's Rescue
QuestInfo.0: #p2144004# is injured, and needs help. Talk to her to find out what you can do.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the monsters around #p2144004# so that she can rest and recover.
QuestInfo.2: You must proceed in #p2144004#'s place, and investigate the distorted past.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] Fallen Hero quest

0.0: My injuries aren't severe, but I shouldn't move just yet. I don't want to make anything worse. Could you help me out?\r\n#L0##b(She fooled me so many times before...but this is serious. Will she be okay?) How can I help?#l\n#k
0.1: I just need a breather. Eliminate the nearby monsters while I rest, and I should be good to go in no time.

yes.0: I feel terrible...getting hurt at a time like this, and leaving things up to you. Heh, don't worry, though. I'll be fine soon enough.

no.0: Look, I'm not messing around here. I really need your help.

1.0: Man, you've improved a lot since last time. I feel well enough to move, but continuing the mission... that's not happening.

yes.0: I'm sorry, but I just can't go on. I need you to take over, #h0#. Please... find out what's going on. We can't let Arkarium get away with whatever it is he's doing!

mob.0: I think... I should rest a bit more. Please keep the monsters away for a bit. I think I can get enough rest while you eliminate 30 of them.
